# Field Service MCP connectors

4 field service connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All field service connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/field-service](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/field-service).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Jobber](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/jobber-to-mcp) | Jobber field service software for home service businesses: clients and properties, requests, quotes, jobs and scheduled visits, invoices, users and products and services, through Jobber's GraphQL API with OAuth. | 29 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-jobber-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-jobber-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-jobber-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-jobber-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-jobber-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-jobber-to-muse) |
| [MFR Mobile Field Report](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp) | Manage field service operations with Mobile Field Report (MFR). | 71 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-muse) |
